pumi.events.v1.InvocationRequested.jsons.description:
InvocationRequested is the data of dev.getpumi.invocation.requested: the
 kernel's intent to invoke a harness.

^(document_hash)$.description:
The hash of the invocation document: sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of
 document.

document.description:
The invocation document, as the binary protobuf of
 pumi.runner.v1.Invocation, which Claim returns to the runner that
 claims the invocation (decision 0165). It is bytes, not the message,
 because the runner protocol is versioned apart from the event schema
 (decision 0041) and pumi.runner.v1 imports this file.

documentHash.description:
The hash of the invocation document: sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of
 document.

plan.description:
The plan that the invocation is for, which the kernel names, so that
 the usage and the planning output of an invocation are found for its
 plan and a plan cancel reaches the plan's invocations (decision 0175).

pumi.events.v1.InvocationRequested.jsons.title: Invocation Requested
